name: Tea Party
source:
Magical moon diadem is passed in royal family of kingdom Amuria from generation to generation. Young princess reaches 16 years old, but diadem rejects her. Princess only has two months to become worthy of the artifact. Intrigues, assassinations and death traps await her on the way to learn popular support and true love.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
魔法月冠在阿穆里亞王國的王室中世代相傳。年輕的公主年滿16歲，卻遭月冠拒絕。她只有兩個月時間，證明自己配得上這件神器。為了贏得民眾支持、找到真愛，她將面對宮廷陰謀、刺殺和死亡陷阱。

［譯自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]］
